text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: Kaya climbs the tower, still reeling from her earlier bout with Kaori. As more monsters show up, she directs her irritation at them.
text_block_list.orig_text:
先程のカオリとの手合わせを引きずったまま塔を登るカヤ。
そのいら立ちは魔物に向けられていた。

text_block_list.name: Kaya
text_block_list.text: Doraaa!
text_block_list.orig_text: ドラァ！

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: Gyaoooooo!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──ギャオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Kaya
text_block_list.text: Tch, no matter how many monsters I defeat, I still don't understand... What is so different between me and Kaori?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ちっ、
いくら魔物を倒しても全然分かんねえ……
オレとカオリは何がそんなに違うんだ。

text_block_list.name: カヤ
text_block_list.text:
あるいは……
単純にカオリよりもずっと弱いだけなのか？
text_block_list.orig_text:
あるいは……
単純にカオリよりもずっと弱いだけなのか？

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: ...Hey, Kaya? Do you have a moment?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……ねえカヤ？　
ちょっといいかな──

text_block_list.name: Kaya
text_block_list.text: ...! Kaori, did you notice?
text_block_list.orig_text:
っ！　
カオリ、
気付いたか？

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: Yeah, I can tell. These monsters are pretty strong~sa
text_block_list.orig_text:
うん、
分かるよ。
あの魔物たち、
すごく強いさ～

text_block_list.name: Monsters
text_block_list.text: ...GUOOOH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Kaya
text_block_list.text: They’re... instinctively aiming for an easy-to-defeat opponent! Kaori!
text_block_list.orig_text:
アイツら、
本能的に倒しやすい相手を狙ってるのか！　
カオリ！

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: Heard you loud and clear~sa! I'll take on each of you one by one!
text_block_list.orig_text:
はいさ～！　
一人一体お相手するよ～

text_block_list.name: Monster 1
text_block_list.text: ...GUOOOH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Kaya
text_block_list.text: Whoa, what power! And this thing... it looks quite sturdy. ...Can I really defeat it? With such a lacking fist...
text_block_list.orig_text:
うおっ、
なんてパワーだ！　
それにこいつ、
見るからに頑丈だな。
……倒せるのか？　
オレの拳で。

text_block_list.name: Monster 2
text_block_list.text: ...GUOOOH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: Wawawa~ What a fast monster~sa! No, that's not all. Its movements are like those of a beast with no shape, it's hard to read.
text_block_list.orig_text:
わわわ～
なんて速い魔物さ～。
ううん、
それだけじゃない。
型のない獣みたいな動き、
これは読みづらいね～

text_block_list.name: Monsters
text_block_list.text: ...GUOOOH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Kaya
text_block_list.text: Guah...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ぐあ
っ……！

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: Ow, this is going to be pretty tough~sa
text_block_list.orig_text:
あいた～、
これはなかなか手強いさ～

text_block_list.name: Kaya
text_block_list.text: This isn't good... Let's retreat for now and get ourselves better prepared!
text_block_list.orig_text:
このままじゃマズい……
一旦退いて
態勢を整えるぞ！

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: Kh... Understood~sa!
text_block_list.orig_text: 了解さ～！

text_block_list.name: Kaya
text_block_list.text: Hah, hah... Tch, those bastards are persistent. At this rate, they'll catch up to us.
text_block_list.orig_text:
はぁ、
はぁ……
ちっ、
あのヤローどもしつこいな。
このままじゃ追いつかれちまう。

text_block_list.name: Kaya
text_block_list.text: Hey, Kaori, take him and run. I'll take care of things here.
text_block_list.orig_text:
おいカオリ、
カレを連れて逃げろ。
オレが殿をつとめてやるよ。

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: That's out of the question~ Because we're going to beat those monsters~sa!
text_block_list.orig_text:
それは却下だよ～
だって私たちは
あの魔物たちに勝つからさ～

text_block_list.name: Kaya
text_block_list.text: Don't be stupid! You and I both weren't a match for those things! Even if you were able to find a way to win, Kaori, I...
text_block_list.orig_text:
バカ言うな！　
オレもアンタも全然歯が立たなかったじゃねえか！
たとえカオリは勝てたとしても、
オレは……

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: I was going to say this earlier, but you're very strong, you know, Kaya? If we were to spar seriously, it would be impossible to predict who would win~sa
text_block_list.orig_text:
さっきも言おうと思ったけど、
カヤは強いよ～？
もし本気で手合わせしてたら
勝敗は予想もつかないさ～

text_block_list.name: Kaya
text_block_list.text: The heck, I don't need flattery at a time like this.
text_block_list.orig_text:
なんだよ、
こんな時にお世辞なんていらねえよ。

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: I'm not just saying this to flatter you~ When we sparred, and the reason why I was able to defeat the monster you struggled with, Kaya, was simply because of our compatibility~
text_block_list.orig_text:
お世辞じゃないよ～
手合わせの時、
それからカヤが苦戦した魔物を倒せたのも、
単純に相性の問題だったからね～

text_block_list.name: Kaya
text_block_list.text: Compatibility, you say...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
相性、
だって……？

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: That's right~ I have techniques that Kaya doesn't have~sa! Which is why I was able to dodge your attacks and defeat that monster in one blow~
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうだよ～、
私はカヤにはない技を持ってるさ～
だからカヤの攻撃をいなせたし、
魔物を一撃で倒せたんさ～

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: But, that's all it comes down to~sa! I'm not stronger than you, Kaya~ So you'll never lose if you just believe in your strength and give it your all~!
text_block_list.orig_text:
でも、
それだけのことさ～。
私がカヤより強いわけじゃないよ～
だからカヤは
自分の強さを信じて戦えば
絶対に負けないさ～！

text_block_list.name: Kaya
text_block_list.text: ...Maybe so. But I don't have a place or family I want to protect like you do, Kaori. That in itself creates a big difference between us, doesn't it?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……かもしれないな。
でも、
オレにはカオリみたいに
守りたい場所も家族もない。
その差はデカいだろ？

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: Aha~! Isn't that a weird way to think? If there's someone you want to protect, I think he's always by yours side~sa!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あは～、
おかしなこと言うね～？
守りたい人なら、
ず～っと側にいるさ～

text_block_list.name: Kaya
text_block_list.text: ...Oh, you're right. How did I even forget what I came here for? I was so caught up in fighting that I completely lost sight of my surroundings.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……あ。
そうだ、
オレはここに何しに来たんだよ。
ケンカにかまけて
すっかり周りが見えなくなっちまってたぜ。

text_block_list.name: Kaya
text_block_list.text: It's true that I don't have the same martial arts training that Kaori does. But my fists, forged through countless battles, are far from weak.
text_block_list.orig_text:
たしかにオレには
カオリみたいな武術の心得はない。
だけどいくつもの修羅場で鍛え上げられた拳は
決してやわじゃねえ。

text_block_list.name: Kaya
text_block_list.text: If I can't trust even in my own fists, there's no way I'd be able to win even if I could. Thanks, Kaori. You protected my heart and fists both.
text_block_list.orig_text:
自分の拳を信じられなきゃ
勝てるもんも勝てやしねえよな。
あ
りがとよカオリ。
アンタはオレの心も拳も守ってくれた。

text_block_list.name: Kaya
text_block_list.text: I know this isn’t much of a thank-you... But I’ll prove the strength you saw in me—without a doubt!
text_block_list.orig_text:
礼と言っちゃあなんだけど、
カオリが認めてくれたオレの強さ、
きっちりと証明してみせるぜ！

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: Yeah, yeah! That's the spirit! I love Kaya's honest and passionate fists~sa!
text_block_list.orig_text:
うんうん、
その意気だよ～
私、
カヤの真っすぐで熱い拳が大好きさ～！

text_block_list.name: Monsters
text_block_list.text: ...GUOOOH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Kaya
text_block_list.text: Perfect timing—here they come. Kaori, leave the fast one to me. My strikes are better suited to match its speed.
text_block_list.orig_text:
お、
丁度ヤツらのお出ましだ。
カオリ、
あの速いのはオレに任せろ。
オレの打撃の方が
野郎に合わせやすそうだからな。

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: Well then, leave the one that looks tough to me~sa! My techniques should be able to break through both strength and hardness~
text_block_list.orig_text:
それじゃあ硬い方は私にお任せさ～
私の技なら
剛腕も硬さも
打ち破れるはずだよ～

text_block_list.name: Kaya
text_block_list.text: Come on, round two is starting!
text_block_list.orig_text:
さあ、
第二ラウンドといこうか！

text_block_list.name: Monster 2
text_block_list.text: ...GUOOOH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Kaya
text_block_list.text: Haha! Isn't that nice? You can go faster than one's eye can see? But... there you are! Next up... that way, come on! What's wrong? Is that all you can do? Then I'll go next!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ははっ！　
いいな、
目にも留まらぬ速さってやつか？
でも、
そこだ！　
今度は……
そっちか、
オラァ！
どうした？　
もう終わりか？　
なら、
こっちからいくぜぇ！

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: Kaya... she's reacting to that thing's speed and hitting all possible counter attack~sa!
text_block_list.orig_text:
カヤ、
あの速さに反応し、
ことごとくカウンターを決めてるさ～

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: Her high physical abilities and instincts allow her to make astonishing guesses~ When types like her get serious, they can be the scariest~sa!
text_block_list.orig_text:
高い身体能力と本能が、
驚異的な当て勘を発揮してるんだね～
本気になったらああいうタイプが一番怖いさ～

text_block_list.name: Monster 1
text_block_list.text: ...GUOOOH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: Oops, I can't lose either~ Okay~sa, oi~sa... and since there's an opening! I'll go for it!
text_block_list.orig_text:
おっと、
こっちも負けてられないよ～
はいさ～、
ほいさ～、
隙ができたらどーん！

text_block_list.name: Kaya
text_block_list.text: She managed to avoid all of those powerfully changed attacks... And what's more, that blow is the same she used to take down that rubber bastard earlier, right? It's probably a technique that doesn't destroy things from the outside, but from the inside.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あのとんでもない威力を全部いなしてやがるぜ。
それにあの一撃、
さっきゴム野郎を倒した技だな？
おそらく外から壊すのではなく
内部を破壊する技なんだろうな。

text_block_list.name: カヤ
text_block_list.text:
武を極めた強者の技だ。
へへ、
見てるだけでたぎってくるぜ！
text_block_list.orig_text:
武を極めた強者の技だ。
へへ、
見てるだけでたぎってくるぜ！

text_block_list.name: Monsters
text_block_list.text: Gyaoooooo!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──ギャオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Kaya
text_block_list.text: Wha-... this thing! It must have realized that its no match for me, so it's going after {0} again! Kaori!
text_block_list.orig_text:
なっ、
アイツら敵わないと悟ったのか、
またカレの方に行きやがった！　
カオリ！

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: Yeah! I won't let ANYONE lay a finger on {0}!
text_block_list.orig_text:
うん！　
彼には指一本ふれさせないよ～

text_block_list.name: Kaya
text_block_list.text: Although our fighting styles are different, the feelings we put into our fists are the same!
text_block_list.orig_text:
戦い方は違っても、
拳に込めた思いは同じ！

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: When we’re fighting to protect someone dear—we can become as strong as we need to~!
text_block_list.orig_text:
大事な人を守るためなら、
いくらでも強くなれるさ～！

text_block_list.name: Kaya
text_block_list.text: Take this! DRAGON'S END... FISTTTT!!!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
食らえぇ！　
ドラゴンズエンド、
フィストォォー！

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: I've saved this just for you! Ryukyuan Dog Knuckle Arrow!
text_block_list.orig_text:
とっておきさ～！　
琉球犬ナックルアロー！

text_block_list.name: Monsters
text_block_list.text: Gyaoooooo!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──ギャオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Kaya
text_block_list.text: Pheeew, it's been a while since I've had such a tough fight. But... the excitement was through the roof! And it's all thanks to you, Kaori.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふぅ、
久々にしんどいケンカだったぜ。
でも、
最高にたぎったケンカだったな。
アンタのおかげだ、
カオリ。

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: Aha~♪ I didn't really do anything special~ But, if you're really having fun, Kaya, I'm glad I came~sa!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あは～♪　
私は大したことしてないよ～
でも、
カヤが楽しくなれたのなら、
私が来たかいがあってうれしいさ～

text_block_list.name: Kaya
text_block_list.text: And you, {0}—I dragged you through all sorts of trouble. From now on, I’ll fight with everything I’ve got—for you. I’ll find your memories, no matter what!
text_block_list.orig_text:
キミにもずいぶんと迷惑かけちまったな。
あとはキミのために全力で戦うよ。
必ず記憶を見つけてやるからさ！

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: Kaya made a promise with a clear and refreshed look on her face.
text_block_list.orig_text: 迷いの晴れた清々しい顔で約束するカヤだった。
